bagPolicy.summary: Northwest Stadium follows the NFL clear bag policy for Commanders games. You can bring one clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches or a one-gallon clear freezer bag, plus a small clutch about 4.5 x 6.5 inches. Concert rules may differ, so check your event page before you go.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bag no larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
One-gallon clear plastic freezer bag (Ziploc or similar)
Small clutch about 4.5 x 6.5 inches, with or without a handle or strap, carried with one clear bag
prohibited: Any bag larger than the permitted size
Non-approved seat cushions with pockets, zippers, compartments or covers
bagPolicy.note: Medically necessary items are allowed after inspection at a designated gate. The policy applies on the stadium plaza, at the gates and in queue lines.

parking.note: Pre-purchased parking passes are required on Northwest Stadium property, except for the Gray Lot. The Gray Lot is cash only, first come, first served, and can't be bought in advance. Buy parking early, since prices can change on event day and lots can sell out.
parking.summary: Buy parking in advance for every lot except the cash-only Gray Lot.

rideshare.note: Rideshare drop-off and pickup are in the Red Zone Lot on event days, about a 5-minute walk from the stadium. For drop-off, enter Prince George's County Sports Complex, 8001 Sheriff Rd, as your destination. Pickups can only be requested from the rideshare lot; follow the signs from Gate A. The nearest Metro stop is Morgan Boulevard on the Blue and Silver Lines, about a 20-minute walk with no shuttle.
rideshare.summary: Rideshare drop-off and pickup are in the Red Zone Lot, about 5 minutes from the stadium on foot.

concessions.note: Food is sold on the 100, 300 and 400 levels, with local picks like Ben's Chili Bowl, DMV Crab Cage, Peruvian Brothers and Factoria Maria Pupuseria alongside burgers, pizza and BBQ.
concessions.summary: Stands on every level carry local DC-area food as well as stadium staples.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking and seating are limited and first come, first served, so buy accessible seats in advance and arrive early. Public ramps are next to Gates A, H, E and D, and elevators are at Gate A and Gate E; get an elevator wristband at any Guest Services booth. Assisted listening devices are available at the Gate A Guest Services booth, and sensory kits can be checked out at main concourse Guest Services booths. Service dogs and miniature horses trained for a disability are allowed; emotional support animals are not. Email guestservices@northweststadium.com with questions.
accessibility.summary: Ramps, elevators at Gates A and E, assisted listening and sensory kits are available.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Once you leave the stadium, you can't come back in unless you have a full, unused ticket for that day's event.
reEntry.summary: There is no re-entry once you exit.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The stadium's official pages don't list a will call or box office location. For ticket help, contact the Ticket Office at 301-276-6050 or tickets@northweststadium.com.
ticketPickup.summary: Contact the Ticket Office at 301-276-6050 for ticket help.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Gate opening times vary and are posted on each event's page. All fans go through set screening locations, which can cause delays. Elevators are at Redwire Gate (Gate A) and Bank of America Gate (Gate E), and Guest Services booths are across from Sections 104, 124, 304, 324, 404 and 431.
gates.summary: Gate times vary by event and are posted on the event page.
